reason: Cline preparation blocked: Issue #3 'Sovryn Contract Governance Dashboard' is a Gitcoin bounty/grant product request, not a concrete code change to SovrynBTC/Ecosystem-Bounties. Evidence: (1) The issue text solicits development+design labour for an EXTERNAL product: 'This bounty covers the cost of developing according to the following spec plus domain registration and 6 months of hosting on a dedicated public webpage', with a rate card ('$2000/week for fulltime dev work', '$750/week for design work') and 'Contact @ingalandia on Twitter or email (i@sovryn.app) to claim this bounty and negotiate timeline before beginning work.' It specifies a data dashboard fed from The Graph/RSK, i.e. a from-scratch web product deliverable, not a defect or focused feature in this repository. (2) Repository state confirms there is no code surface to change: default branch 'main' has exactly one commit 9c012499504c724310c7adff494781a3cfc7ec3a ('Initial commit') whose only tracked file is README.md (114 bytes, a one-line description). GET /languages returns {} (no source code); there is no .github, no CI, no manifest, no lockfile, no test harness. (3) Funding is not live: the claim link recorded in the issue's own gitcoinbot comment, https://gitcoin.co/issue/sovrynbtc/ecosystem-bounties/3/100027887, returns HTTP 404 (Gitcoin-classic is defunct), and the bounty is a 2022 request whose repository was last pushed 2021-12-27. (4) No competition to build on: GET /pulls?state=all returns 0 pull requests. Per the phase rules, a grant/proposal request or a generic product idea without a repository change must be reported blocked with the checkout left unchanged; no baseline/regression commands apply because there is no buildable target in this repository.
